title: Maggot
wikitext:
[[image:Maggot.png|thumb|]]

Maggots are emplyed as the young stage of various insectoid creatures, notably the [[Silithid]]s and [[Nerubian]]s.

Maggots inhabit only a few places in the world of [[Azeroth]], often among more adult stages of Silithid such as in [[the Barrens]], or in huge variants in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]]. They usually come in shades of white, yellow or green, and may or may not be aggressive.

Maggots vary quite much in size, from the cat-sized larvae of the Silithid to the enormous carrion grubs of the Plaguelands, the largest of which can be the size of elephants.
